title: Photothermal methane dry reforming: catalyst architectures, mechanistic pathways, and future challenges
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00417A, Review Article
Ruijie Yang, Chengxuan He, Yuan Dong, Weihao Chen, Lingyun Chen, Zhihan Wang, Miao Kan, Shiqun Wu, Jinlong Zhang
This review summarizes advances in photothermal methane dry reforming, highlighting catalyst architectures, mechanistic insights, and challenges to guide future catalyst design.
